issues.reason: Passing a bill neither creates, destroys, consumes nor physically changes it, and none of the stated non-physical extensions (an occurrence's happening/timing, an informational artifact's content) applies; the instruction set's own 'The committee approved the plan -> (Theme sk_approve_1 sk_plan_1)' fixes the role for this verb class, with Theme also the stated default when the test is unclear.

gaps_confirmed: second-person 'you' with no antecedent — the pronoun rule enumerates he/she/they/it only, so the minted witness's class is unlicensed guesswork
journalistic party-district apposition 'D-Waco' — no covered encoding; the parse drops it
a direct quotation as an attitude complement — Propositional attitudes covers finite 'that'-clauses only
a sealed Implication has no TV slot, so the quoted conditional's strength/confidence cannot be recorded
new_gaps: a conditional as the sealed content of an attitude: Sealing specifies a single atom or an (And …) term, and says nothing about nesting an Implication, whose free rule variables then sit inside a stored term
'Big Brother' is a culturally allusive proper noun with no kind atom available — Names & casing requires the entity's kind in an ordinary type atom, which this text never supplies
repair_summary: Inside the sealed conditional's antecedent, changed (Patient sk_pass_1 sk_bill_1) to (Theme sk_pass_1 sk_bill_1); no other content changed.
notes: The title handling on 'Rep. John Mabry', the Agent/Stimulus split for watch, Future+Ongoing for 'will be watching', and the top-level projection of the definite 'this bill' out of the seal all hold.
